fields.title: ASIN product / Buy Box record
fields.description: Two record shapes, discriminated by `recordType`. PRODUCT is one Amazon product looked up by ASIN. CAPTCHA_ESCALATION marks an ASIN that could not be fetched (bot wall) or an input that was not a valid ASIN, so a short run is never mistaken for a short catalogue. Amazon omits the Buy Box block from roughly half of anonymous product pages; `buyBoxDataAvailable` says whether seller data was served at all, so a null seller is never mistaken for 'sold by Amazon'. Every field is nullable accordingly.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The ASIN (or raw input value) this row came from.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-dp-page for a scraped product, S0-diagnostic for a failure row.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Amazon domain suffix the row was scraped from.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Brand or store name, with Amazon's 'Visit the ... Store' wrapper stripped.

price.title: Price
price.description: Current displayed price. Null when Amazon served no price (unavailable listings).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency symbol or code as displayed. Pinned to the marketplace, not the proxy's country.

availability.title: Availability text
availability.description: Raw availability line, e.g. 'In Stock' or 'Only 3 left in stock'.

inStock.title: In stock
inStock.description: Tri-state. Null means Amazon served no stock signal at all — not 'out of stock'.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Condition of the offer shown. Anonymous pages carry the New offer; used and refurbished offers are not exposed to logged-out clients.

featureBullets.title: Feature bullets
featureBullets.description: Bullet points from the product description block.

buyBoxDataAvailable.title: Buy Box data available
buyBoxDataAvailable.description: Whether Amazon served the Buy Box seller block for this request. False means the data was withheld — NOT that Amazon is the seller. Read every seller field below as unknown when this is false.

buyBoxSellerId.title: Buy Box seller ID
buyBoxSellerId.description: Merchant ID of the Buy Box winner. ATVPDKIKX0DER is Amazon's own retail account.

buyBoxSellerName.title: Buy Box seller name
buyBoxSellerName.description: Display name of the Buy Box winner.

buyBoxIsAmazon.title: Buy Box is Amazon
buyBoxIsAmazon.description: True when Amazon retail holds the Buy Box. Null when no seller was served.

shipsFrom.title: Ships from
shipsFrom.description: Fulfilment party, which may differ from the seller (FBA).

returnPolicy.title: Return policy
returnPolicy.description: Return window as stated on the product page, e.g. '30 days returnable' or 'Non-returnable'.

hasAddToCart.title: Has add-to-cart
hasAddToCart.description: Whether a purchasable Buy Box was rendered.

parentAsin.title: Parent ASIN
parentAsin.description: Parent of this variation family, when the product has variants.

variationCount.title: Variation count
variationCount.description: Number of variants in the family.

variationDimensions.title: Variation dimensions
variationDimensions.description: Dimension labels the family varies on, e.g. Size, Flavor Name.

isVariationChild.title: Is variation child
isVariationChild.description: True when this row was fetched by expanding another ASIN's variation family.

changeType.title: Change type
changeType.description: NEW, UNCHANGED, PRICE_INCREASED, PRICE_DECREASED, BUYBOX_SELLER_CHANGED, BACK_IN_STOCK or OUT_OF_STOCK. Null when change tracking is off.

changes.title: All changes
changes.description: Every change detected this run, when more than one applies.

previousPrice.title: Previous price
previousPrice.description: Price recorded in the previous run.

previousSellerId.title: Previous seller ID
previousSellerId.description: Buy Box seller recorded in the previous run.

priceDelta.title: Price delta
priceDelta.description: Current minus previous price. Negative means the price dropped.

priceDeltaPercent.title: Price delta percent
priceDeltaPercent.description: Price change as a percentage of the previous price.

previousScrapedAt.title: Previous scraped at
previousScrapedAt.description: Timestamp of the snapshot being compared against.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: BLOCKED or INVALID_ASIN on a diagnostic row, otherwise null.
